entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a four-direction survivor reference sheet for Grave Accord. The supplied image is the identity and finish authority. Mara Rook, the SAME woman in the reference: navy watch cap, short brown hair, navy long watch coat with worn ochre badge, brown belt and boots, compact antique service pistol. Preserve her face, body proportions, costume and palette. Create a clean 1024 by 1024 transparent sheet divided into four equal 512 by 512 cells, with no visible grid or labels. Top-left: facing south toward the viewer; top-right: facing east in right profile; bottom-left: facing north, unmistakably rear view with the back of head/hood and coat; bottom-right: facing west in left profile. Each complete figure stands in a ready pose, weapon pointing in its facing direction with correct foreshortening. Fixed scale, figure height about 365 pixels in each cell, both feet rest on baseline y=438 within the cell and body centered x=256. Use a slightly elevated top-down game-camera view consistently, not an overhead map view. Original hand-ink contours and matte gouache, quiet broad clothing planes, clean silhouette, selective face/hand/weapon detail, no visual noise. No scenery, platform, shadow backdrop, particles, text, arrows or frame. Actual transparent background. Four clear views of one unchanged survivor, exactly one figure per cell.
entries.review: Four legible views, subject identity broadly retained. Requires finish consistency, shared-scale and in-motion approval before production use.
